items.item: Each row shows the user's name and email, role, status in words (such as Active, Invited, Deactivated, Locked) and whether two-factor sign-in is enabled
items.evidence: renderRow() emits name, email, role and statusBadge(u.status) ('Hoạt động'/'Đã mời'/'Vô hiệu hóa' — words), but no cell or icon anywhere represents two-factor/2FA status; no '2FA'/'hai yếu tố' string exists in the page or data model (users only have id/name/email/role/status/lastLogin/createdAt).

items.item: Last sign-in uses one date-time format with the timezone stated, relative times also expose the exact time, and an account that has never signed in shows "Never" rather than a blank or a 1970 date
items.evidence: formatDateTime() renders 'dd/mm/yyyy HH:MM' consistently and lastLoginCellHtml() pairs it with the relative string for recent logins ('07/11/2026 15:00 · 10 giờ trước'), satisfying the 'exact time alongside relative' part — but the timezone (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh is used internally, TIME_ZONE var) is never stated in the visible text. Never-signed-in rows render '—' with only an sr-only 'Chưa đăng nhập' label — visually a bare dash, not the word 'Never'/'Chưa từng đăng nhập'.

items.item: Users can be found by searching name or email and filtered by role, status and inactivity (such as no sign-in for 90+ days), with the number of matching users shown
items.evidence: searchInput + matchesNonStatus() matches against foldVi(u.name + ' ' + u.email); roleFilterOptions checkboxes filter state.roles; statusTabs filter state.statusTab; lastLoginSelect option value="90plus" ('Không hoạt động trên 90 ngày') filters inactivity; resultCount textContent shows '<n> người dùng phù hợp'.

items.item: The invite form requires an email and a role, labels both fields, and shows an inline error for a malformed address or one that already has an account
items.evidence: <label for="inviteEmail">Email *</label> and <label for="inviteRole">Vai trò *</label>; submit handler validates required, validEmail() regex ('Nhập email hợp lệ, ví dụ ten@novawork.vn'), and duplicate check against ALL_USERS ('Email này đã có trong hệ thống') writing into #inviteEmailError.

items.item: Deactivation asks for confirmation that names the user and states the effect (active sessions ended, sign-in blocked, data kept), and a deactivated user is offered Reactivate instead
items.evidence: openConfirm title 'Vô hiệu hóa tài khoản ' + user.name + '?' names the user, and disabled users get a menu item {action:'enable', label:'Kích hoạt tài khoản'} (Reactivate) — but the body text is only 'Họ sẽ ngay lập tức mất quyền truy cập vào hệ thống. Bạn có thể kích hoạt lại tài khoản sau.' (lose access / can reactivate later), with no mention of active sessions being ended or data being kept.

items.item: The signed-in administrator's own row is marked (such as "You") and cannot be deactivated or lose the admin role, and the last remaining administrator cannot be deactivated, with the disabled action explaining why
items.evidence: No current-user concept exists anywhere in the script (no 'currentUser'/'self'/'You' string, no row marking); renderRow()'s menu always offers 'disable'/'remove' regardless of role or admin count, and there is no logic guarding the last 'Quản trị viên' from deactivation.

items.item: Password reset sends a reset link to the user's email address, which the confirmation names, and the administrator never sees, sets or types the new password
items.evidence: handleRowAction('reset') calls toast('Đã gửi email đặt lại mật khẩu cho ' + user.email) — names the recipient email, no password input field exists anywhere for the admin to view/set/type.

items.item: Row actions are buttons or a keyboard-operable menu whose accessible names include the user (such as "Actions for Mai Nguyen"), and the outcome of an action is announced in an aria-live or role="status" region
items.evidence: Trigger button aria-label="Hành động cho " + u.name (e.g. 'Hành động cho Nguyễn Thu Hà'), role="menu"/role="menuitem" built from real <button> elements (focusable/operable); toast() appends messages into #toastRegion which has role="status" aria-live="polite".

items.item: A search with no matching users shows a message with a way to clear it, and loading and failed-load states with a retry exist
items.evidence: emptyStateRow('no-results') shows 'Không có người dùng khớp "..."' plus #emptyClearBtn 'Xóa bộ lọc' that resets all filters; skeletonRows() renders an aria-busy loading table; errorStateRow() shows 'Không thể tải danh sách người dùng' with #retryBtn 'Thử lại' (triggered via ?state=error/empty).

notes: Overall a clean, non-templatey admin list screen (audit score 90/100, only a text-contrast violation on the inactive status-tab counts e.g. div#statusTabs span.text-slate-400 at 2.56:1). No dashboard-style decorative elements (no KPI tiles, gradients, glass, emoji icons, oversized radii, navy/indigo sidebar) were found, so the 'template tell' list is empty. The three failing checklist items are substantive gaps: no 2FA indicator/column, no stated timezone for last-sign-in timestamps (and 'Never' is a bare '—' rather than visible text), no admin-self/last-admin protection or 'You' row marking, and the deactivation confirmation under-states its effects.
